description: The canonical tools/list entries of io.github.draftyak/tool v1. A plugin serving some kinds lists tool_describe, tool_probe and one entry per kind, each equal to its entry here as RFC 8785 JSON: "jcs" is that canonical form (UTF-8) and "sha256" its hash. "declaration" is what a tool plugin declares in server/discover; its schemaDigest is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of spec/schemas/tool-v1.schema.json. "kinds" gives each kind's data class, output ceiling (bytes of the result's canonical JSON) and lookup timeout. "lists" gives, for each set of kinds, the names in order (UTF-16 code units) and the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the entries in that order. In "cases", "result" is a tools/list result as a plugin sent it: it is canonical for "kinds" when its resultType is "complete", it has no nextCursor, and its tools equal the canonical entries by name, in any order, each as canonical JSON; "canonical" is the expected answer.

entries.name: calendar.freebusy

entry.name: calendar.freebusy
entry.title: Calendar free/busy
entry.description: Busy times in a UTC window. Returns intervals only, never event titles, attendees, locations or other event text.

window.description: UTC milliseconds; start is before end.

tz.description: The owner's IANA time zone, for floating times.

busy.description: UTC milliseconds, sorted: each interval starts before it ends and ends before the next one starts.
